_comment: The routing contract this skill exists to enforce. `route` is the tool or skill that must answer the prompt; `why` records the rule that decides it. Pinned by tests/test_sling_routing.py.

routings.prompt: why did this job fail
why is this run failing — here's the Actions URL
routings.why: read, one run; a URL resolves

routings.prompt: what made this run so slow
show me the error lines from that job
which jobs failed in that run
which step in this job failed
what did we spend on CI this month
which workflow is costing us the most
how many runner minutes did each repo use
what runner sizes can we use
am I signed in to sling
re-run the failed jobs
cancel that run
kick off the release workflow
disable that workflow for now
download the build artifact from that run
routings.why: changes local state; sling has no artifact command

routings.prompt: are the checks green on my PR
routings.why: PR-scoped; sling has no PR command

routings.prompt: approve the pending production deployment
routings.why: changes state; no first-class gh subcommand

routings.prompt: grade my CI
routings.why: repo-wide ask about workflow configuration, not one run

routings.why: repo-wide ask about workflow configuration, not one run

routings.prompt: why did CI fail on my last push

routings.prompt: what's breaking the nightly build

routings.prompt: is this test actually broken or just flaky
routings.why: read, failure classification; compare the classified cause across recent runs, not one log
